description: Values that force RFC 4180 quoting: a name written surname-first carries a comma, and a note quoting that name carries one too. Quoting shifts a value's bytes in the file without moving it within its cell, which is what tabular source ranges exist to record.

slots.name: inverted
slots.label: person_name
slots.note: Written surname-first, so the comma forces RFC 4180 quoting and the value's bytes in the file no longer match its offsets in the cell.
